name: 2015-2016_Wexford County Landfill_District Compliance File.pdf
description: Eight-page paper scan covering termination of NPDES certificate MIS111718 and the related industrial-stormwater inspection file. The spill/SOR complaint table is blank; this is not the March 2016 Part 115 Citation 432 record.

name: e-mail cov let-Wexford Landfill.pdf
description: July 12 cover email transmitting the draft groundwater authorization, public notice and certification form and assigning the applicant responsibility for public notice under Rule 2117.

name: email-final authorization-Wexford Landfill.pdf
description: September 16, 2016 DEQ email transmitting the final groundwater-discharge authorization for Wexford County Landfill as an attached Rule 2210 permit document. The email establishes transmittal of the authorization; it does not document leachate deliveries, PFAS results or a migration pathway.

name: Fig 1 - Site Location.pdf
description: Golder Associates Figure 1 site-location map dated February 20, 2012 and later submitted with the Rule 2210(y) groundwater-discharge application. It outlines the Wexford County Landfill on the USGS 7.5-minute Cadillac North topographic quadrangle and includes Michigan and Wexford County locator insets. The map provides regional orientation only; it does not depict PFAS results, monitoring wells or a groundwater-flow pathway.

name: Fig 2 - Site Plan.pdf
description: Facility plan showing existing and proposed cells, monitoring wells, secondary sampling locations and discharge locations.

name: Fig 3 - Reg Water Well Location.pdf
description: Regional water-well location map showing documented well identifiers around the landfill.

name: Fig 4 - Wetland Location.pdf
description: Wetland-location map submitted as part of the Rule 2210(y) isolation-distance documentation.

name: Fig 5 - North Topo.pdf
description: Northern topographic sheet locating the evaporator lagoon, spray curtain, discharge hose and proposed overland-flow discharge area.

name: Fig 6 - South Topo.pdf
description: Southern topographic sheet showing the landfill boundary, proposed industrial cells, roads and nearby structures.

name: Flow Rate - Days.pdf
description: Application calculation using a 4.5-acre discharge area, 35-gpm flow and approximately 900,000 gallons, with conservative April and May operating-day estimates.

name: lagoon summary.pdf
description: Thirty-page scan containing chain-of-custody records, December 2015 lagoon sample results, analytical parameter tables and laboratory QA/QC. Two MiEnviro document IDs resolve to this one retained original.

name: PN certification form-Wexford Landfill.pdf
description: Blank public-notice certification form transmitted with the proposed Rule 2210(y) authorization; distinct from the completed certification already indexed in Category 02.

name: public notice email-Wexford Landfill.pdf
description: DEQ email sent July 12, 2016 at 3:36 PM transmitting the Wexford County Landfill public-notice package, directing publication by July 15 and requesting confirmation of receipt. The message says a prior public-notice email from the preceding week was not received and apologizes for the delay; it does not itself verify that newspaper publication occurred by July 15.

name: Rule 2210 Permit Template draft-Wexford Landfill.pdf
description: Twenty-page draft authorization for groundwater permit GW1010342. It proposes limits and monitoring for a one-time diluted landfill-leachate discharge by overland flow and spray bar.

name: Rule 2210 Permit Template-Wexford Landfill.docx
description: Final 26-page permit GW1010342, issued September 6, effective October 1, 2016 and expiring January 31, 2017. It authorizes up to 50,400 gallons/day and 2,000,000 gallons/year. The source has a .docx filename but contains a valid PDF payload.

name: Wexford Landfill Groundwater Discharge Permit Application 2210(y).docx
